title: Dashboard
description: ObserveSpec v0: one SlashObserve dashboard. Absent fields mean the default. Frozen for milestone 1 (Ishan, 2026-10-18).

timezone.description: browser, utc or an IANA zone such as Asia/Kolkata.

cursorSync.description: How hovering one time chart shows on the others: off, crosshair (the hovered time is marked on every time chart) or tooltip (their tooltips open too). Grafana's graphTooltip 0, 1 and 2.

panels.description: At most 200 panels in total, row children included; ids are unique across all of them.

timeExpression.description: Relative (now, now-6h, now+1d, now-1d/d) or absolute RFC 3339 time.

datasourceUid.title: DatasourceUid
datasourceUid.description: A configured datasource uid; its type comes from the server's registry.

datasourceRef.title: DatasourceRef
datasourceRef.description: A configured datasource uid, or ${name} naming a datasource variable declared in variables (before this variable, when used by one); queries then run on the datasource selected in that variable, and macros follow its datasourceType.

intervalRef.title: IntervalRef
intervalRef.description: A minimum step such as 30s, or ${name} naming an interval variable; queries then use the step selected in that variable.

color.title: Color
color.description: A semantic color (ok, info, warning, critical) or a #rrggbb hex color.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: A Grafana unit id, or a custom suffix:/prefix: unit.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Default selection: one value, several for a multi variable, or $__all.

gridPos.title: GridPos
gridPos.description: Position on the 24-column grid; x + w must not exceed 24.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Only the first step may omit value; it is then the base color below every other step.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: Value mapping; needs text, color or both.

link.title: Link
link.description: Panel, dashboard or data link; ${var} and ${__data.fields.x} are interpolated.

fieldProps.title: FieldProps
fieldProps.description: Display properties shared by a panel and its overrides.

intervalFactor.description: Grafana's resolution 1/N: the query's step is multiplied by N.

panelQuery.title: PanelQuery
panelQuery.description: ref defaults to A, B, C by position; datasource defaults to the panel's.

expr.description: field_or_number op field_or_number, op one of + - * /.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.
Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

mode.description: markdown (default): Markdown with sanitized inline HTML. html: sanitized HTML. code: the content shown as code. The agent never writes HTML.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

placeholderPanel.title: PlaceholderPanel
placeholderPanel.description: Written only by the importer for a Grafana panel we cannot render yet; the agent may move or delete it but not create one.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

rowPanel.title: RowPanel
rowPanel.description: Child panels are always nested, collapsed or not.

fieldName.title: FieldName
fieldName.description: A field name or series name in the panel's frames.

canvasColor.title: CanvasColor
canvasColor.description: A color, or field to take the bound field's threshold or mapping color.

httpsUrl.description: An https address whose host is written out; ${var} references may appear only after the host.

dashlistPanel.title: DashlistPanel
dashlistPanel.description: Links to other dashboards on this server; no datasource or queries.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

newsPanel.title: NewsPanel
newsPanel.description: The latest items of one RSS or Atom feed, fetched by the server for allowlisted domains; no datasource or queries.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

feedUrl.description: An https RSS or Atom feed URL. The server fetches it only when its domain is on the outbound allowlist.
